fusions.name: Sluggish Wash
fusions.desc: Pushes a wide cone of water 4 tiles long that deals 3 damage to everything in it, with a 40% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 4 seconds. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Heavy Current
fusions.desc: A rolling swell on a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 28 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Gentle Current
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you and your allies for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Calf in Tow
fusions.desc: A bonded sea calf swims with you, striking enemies within 4 tiles for 3 damage every 1.4 seconds. Each kill restores 2 health to you.
